_about: Holiday touch for TulsaGays posts (William 2026-11-18: 'give them a little extra special holiday touch when they land on a holiday month. Elegantly classy and minimalist but give it some extra flair'). content/holiday_theme.py reads this. A week is themed by its Thursday (ISO midweek), so a Nov 30 to Dec 6 deck is a December deck. Colors stay inside the TulsaGays palette (no burnt orange, no gold deco lines, no rainbow bars, which are HHHH's look). Every line here ships verbatim: no em dashes, nothing from preflight_post.BANNED_PHRASES. To add a holiday, add an entry; set TULSAGAYS_HOLIDAY=off to disable, TULSAGAYS_HOLIDAY_DATE=YYYY-MM-DD to preview a month.
